maintainers.maintainer_details: The CHoRUS consortium, coordinated from Massachusetts General Hospital, maintains the dataset; Ciera McCrary, MGH, Program Manager, is the contact listed on the project website (cmccrary@mgh.havard.edu).
maintainers.source_caveats: The email address is reproduced exactly as published on chorus4ai.org, where the domain appears as "mgh.havard.edu"; this looks like a typographical error in the source and was not corrected.

maintainers.maintainer_details: Access requests are received by the CHoRUS contacts dbold@emory.edu and jared.houghtaling@tuftsmedicine.org.
Versions, maintainers, and other metadata about the CHoRUS software packages that support the dataset are tracked on the package status page compiled in the chorus-developer repository.

receipt_links.snippet: You can check the versions, maintainers, and other metadata about CHoRUS packages using our package status page
